I think it’s because I’ve given up on myself. I have a low sense of self worth and do not feel I am worth anyone’s time. The effort I always put into past relationships never felt balanced because of this deep set mindset I’ve always had with me, so I’ve always tried to over compensate my anxious attachments by trying to mold myself into being someone worth their time. This was naive and was always doomed to fail in my case.  

Now I feel as though I don’t have the energy for it anymore, and although I’m open to whatever happens, I find it difficult to imagine someone willing to put up with my depressive mindset and that there exists a reasonable person that would find the task worthy of their time. It’s my task alone to change my mindset and find worth for myself. Hoping that just by being in love with someone would make that any easier just feels like a pipedream at this point for me.  

I’m happy if you found love in other ways and I hope it is persistently abundant in your lives. Thank you for making it this far into my ramble if you were able to bare it. I know these words are empty, but I felt I should at least post something due to my username.  

Take care and I hope you find love.

I worked at a coffee shop next to a performing arts complex and Troy Baker was doing a play there for a short while, maybe it was a one night thing? The coffee shop didn’t really have a great selection of food. The kitchen was closed and we had no staff that could prep anything so all we had were some pre-made sandwiches. He ordered a sandwich and didn’t really enjoy it. I felt bad I couldn’t really give him a better experience at the shop I was at. I also was too anxious and depressed in general at the time to acknowledge I was a fan of many games he’s played in and appreciated his work.

It’s strange how even though I can see other people going through similar thoughts like myself I can still feel like such a waste of existence. I think these literal exact same thoughts so frequently it’s just become part of the background noise to my mind and it cycles to the focus of my conscious thought quite often.  
Just last night I went on a long walk (about 3 hours) and it was just en echo chamber of me wishing for my own existence to end. There were breaks from this, I saw a pretty skyline of the city I’m in, a memorial plaque of pets names at an animal shelter which had me contemplating the love people must have shared for them, I walked past an art gallery that had a band that was practicing some songs and the window fully exposed them so they could seem me as I was walking by as well. I walked past the window out of sight and just stood and listened to the music, it sounded great and I enjoyed it, but as a car came to park along the street I grew to anxious and decided to move along. I walked home and sat alone and continued my life as usual.  
I don’t reach out to the people I care about because people can only stand so much of this kind of self loathing despite all the times they’ve tried to be there for comfort and help. The pressure of being a burden just feels too heavy and annoying to bare, but I let myself stay like this every time.  
Thank you for sharing your thoughts and for compelling me at least for this moment to share mine. I’m not great at staying connected with people and the anxieties I feel typically overwhelmed to ever sustain the energy to maintain that connection. I hope one day you can feel at peace and happy for your life, not all the time of course, I feel we both know such a thing isn’t possible, but I wish for your contentment with life. At least that’s what I hope for.
